topic: how to open a brokerage account with chase
slug: how to open a brokerage account with chase

steps.narration: Open chase.com and hover over "Investing by J.P. Morgan".
Open the J.P. Morgan Self-Directed Investing page and click "Open an account".
Sign in with your Chase profile, or create one when prompted.
Fill in the application: personal details, employment, and a short investment profile (goals, experience, risk tolerance).
Choose the account type (individual, joint, or retirement) and submit.
Fund the account: transfers from a Chase account are usually available in minutes, from an outside bank in 1 to 3 business days.
You're done: commission-free online stock and ETF trades, with no account minimums.
